principles.statement: For 2D rectangular knapsack with 8-12 item types, MaxRects with hill-climbing over item orderings achieves ~94.8/100, with item ordering being the dominant lever over packer heuristic choice.
principles.regime: Bin 900-2000, 8-12 item types, 1s time limit, profits up to 10^9
principles.mechanism: MaxRects maintains maximal free rectangles enabling efficient best-fit placement. Hill-climbing (swap + insert neighborhoods) over item type orderings finds near-optimal orderings within 0.5s. The ordering determines which items get priority for the best free rectangles, which cascades through the entire packing.
principles.applicability_bounds: Applies when M <= 12 (small enough for effective local search). For very large M, the ordering space becomes too large for hill-climbing to be effective.

principles.statement: Contact perimeter heuristic is too slow for this time budget (1s) due to O(n^2) per-placement cost of tracking placed rectangles, and reduces effective search iterations.
principles.regime: 1s time limit with hundreds of placements per test case
principles.mechanism: Each placement requires checking overlap with all previously placed rectangles to compute contact perimeter. With 100-1000 placements per test and 15 tests, this overhead reduces the number of ordering permutations that can be evaluated.
principles.applicability_bounds: May be worth it with longer time budgets (>5s) or fewer placements per test.

principles.statement: For 2D rectangular knapsack with 8-12 item types, SA over joint (ordering × per-item-heuristic) space achieves ~95.2/100, a 0.37-point improvement over ordering-only hill-climbing. The per-item heuristic dimension is the key lever; SA over orderings alone matches hill-climbing.
principles.regime: 2D rectangular knapsack, bin 900-2000, 8-12 item types, 1s time budget, MaxRects with 4 heuristics
principles.mechanism: Per-item heuristic selection is the dominant lever.
principles.applicability_bounds: Applies with 4 heuristics. Superseded by RP-5 for 8 heuristics. Score of 95.2 is the 4-heuristic ceiling with default SA parameters; with tuned SA (cooling 0.995, 3 restarts) the 4-heuristic score reaches 95.8 (see RP-5).

principles.statement: Residual gap filling after ordered packing provides zero additional value when per-item heuristic selection is optimized. The ordered pack with individually-tuned heuristics per item type leaves no exploitable residual space.
principles.regime: M=8-12 item types, bins 900-2000, MaxRects with 4 heuristics, SA-optimized per-item heuristic assignment
principles.mechanism: Gap filling tries to place remaining copies of item types (sorted by value density) into free rectangles left after ordered packing. When per-item heuristic selection is optimized, the packing already achieves near-maximal space utilization, leaving free rectangles too small for any item type.
principles.applicability_bounds: May not hold if per-item heuristic selection is NOT optimized (i.e., with fixed heuristic, gap filling might contribute). Also may not hold for very large bins where more residual space exists.

principles.statement: For 2D rectangular knapsack with 8-12 item types, expanding MaxRects from 4 to 8 heuristics with SA over joint (ordering × per-item-heuristic × per-item-rotation) space achieves ~96.5/100. The improvement decomposes as ~55% from expanded heuristics (4→8) and ~45% from SA tuning (faster cooling 0.995, 3 restarts, rotation mode). Both lever types are complementary.
principles.regime: 2D rectangular knapsack, bin 900-2000, 8-12 item types, 1s time budget, MaxRects packer with SA
principles.mechanism: Expanding from 4 to 8 heuristics increases per-item placement options, enabling SA to find better per-item heuristic assignments. Faster cooling (T*=0.995 vs 0.9995) with 3 restarts trades exploration breadth for exploitation depth — appropriate given the larger combinatorial space (8^M vs 4^M for M≈10 item types). Per-item rotation mode adds a third dimension to the SA search that prevents greedy rotation choices from locking in suboptimal orientations.
principles.applicability_bounds: Holds for MaxRects packer under 1s time budget. May not apply with different packing algorithms or much longer time budgets where broader exploration could help.
